skill_concept: Implement missing PyTorch neural network components or reinforcement learning training loops, and diagnose common PyTorch training failures such as gradient issues, loss plateaus, or divergence.
verdict_reason: The skill covers attention-mil (implement missing PyTorch components) and cartpole-rl-training (implement a full RL training loop) well, but classifier-debug requires diagnosing a subtle training bug from symptoms alone — a fundamentally different investigative procedure rather than implementation. While debugging PyTorch failures is nominally part of the candidate skill, the debug task demands a root-cause analysis workflow that diverges substantially from the 'implement components/loops' procedure shape shared by the other two.
weakest_link_reason: This task is purely diagnostic — the agent must identify a hidden bug (likely a loss/label mismatch or data pipeline issue) from loss and accuracy traces without writing any new model components, whereas the other tasks are construction tasks requiring forward-pass or training-loop implementation.
